name: CSS Decisive
note: R13.16, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.42. The Destroyer's hull with a leader's extras, and the differences are worth listing because almost everything else is identical: service year 168 rather than 160, command rating 5 rather than 4, stronger shields, a CENTRE APR PAIR the DD has not got, and plasma-G forward where the DD carries plasma-F. Warp, centre hull, shuttles, impulse and every damage track match the DD exactly. It also has NO PROBES — no launcher box on the hull and no probes table on the sheet, where the DD has both. Unusual for a warship, confirmed by the owner 2026-10-22, and recorded here BECAUSE it is unusual: an absent probe reads exactly like an oversight, and the next person to notice would otherwise 'fix' it. Lined with the DD, as the Federation CC is lined with the CA: a leader groups with its hull family. One refit, so 110 less 4 gives the Y168 hull at 106. The Y180 Sabot refit (+4) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE ALL PLASMA-F TORPEDOES. On this hull that means C and D only, because the forward pair are plasma-G — so the wording differs from the DD's 'delete C and D' while meaning the same thing. R13.1C's rear-firing torpedoes, flagged iscRearFiring; the sheet's pseudo box lists pseudos for A and B and none for these.
